name: Revenge!!! 3 ~Miwaku no Seito Kaichou~
original_name: リベンジ!!! 3 ～魅惑の生徒会長～
source:
Shizuku Shiratori, the student president of my class, invited me to
participate in her big brother's martial art tournament.
My opponent? The very same girl, Shizuku! The perfect girl. The popular girl
that everyone loved. She would hate me for humiliating her...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ095835.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
